# Repository profile: example

```checklist-profile
{
  "name": "example-repository",
  "steps": [
    {"id": "docs-current", "after": "knowledge", "section": "Docs current"},
    {"id": "release-notes", "after": "persist", "section": "Release notes"}
  ]
}
```

## Docs current

Check that the repository's documentation matches what changed.

## Release notes

Add a line to the release notes for any user-visible change.
